description: One Granola meeting in full: the summary Granola wrote (Markdown), who attended, when, the space, a link to Granola, and the start of the transcript. `note` is an object id from get_granola_notes, a Granola note id, or a title. Pass `transcript` true for the transcript rather than the summary when the user asks what exactly was said.

note.description: Object id, Granola id, or title of the meeting.

transcript.description: Return the transcript instead of the summary.

name: get_granola_note
title: Read a Granola meeting note
